fullTextEN: Hello everyone,
I am Xika from Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 今天我想聊聊一个非常非常有名的人，
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about a very, very famous person,

fullTextZH: 可能你早就听过他的名字，
fullTextEN: You might have already heard his name,

fullTextZH: 他就是华语音乐的天王周杰伦，
fullTextEN: He is the king of Mandopop, Jay Chou,

fullTextZH: 他是一个来自台湾的歌手，
fullTextEN: He is a singer from Taiwan,
He not only sings,
but also writes his own songs.
He is also a director and actor.
He is very famous,
a very talented person,

fullTextZH: 他的音乐影响了非常多人。
fullTextEN: His music has influenced many people.

fullTextZH: 今天我想告诉你他长大的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you the story of his upbringing.
Jay Chou was born on January 18, 1979,
born in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 他的爸爸妈妈都是老师，
fullTextEN: His parents are both teachers,
He has no siblings,

fullTextZH: 家里只有他自己一个孩子，
fullTextEN: He is the only child in the family,
so no one played with him.

fullTextZH: 他最喜欢做的事就是听音乐和录音，
fullTextEN: His favorite things to do were listening to music and recording,

fullTextZH: 他会拿着录音机录自己的声音，
fullTextEN: He would hold a tape recorder to record his own voice,

fullTextZH: 录自己唱歌或自己编的故事。
fullTextEN: record himself singing or stories he made up.

fullTextZH: 他也喜欢模仿其他明星，
fullTextEN: He also likes to imitate other celebrities,

fullTextZH: 模仿就是学明星唱歌跳舞的样子。
fullTextEN: Imitating means learning to sing and dance like celebrities.
His mother discovered,
Hmm,
this child really likes music,
and also has a talent for music,

fullTextZH: 所以不顾他爸爸的反对，
fullTextEN: so despite his father's objections,

fullTextZH: 花了很多钱买了一架钢琴，
fullTextEN: she spent a lot of money to buy a piano,
and also sent him to piano lessons.
Just think,

fullTextZH: 喜欢音乐的周杰伦应该很开心吧。
fullTextEN: Jay Chou, who loves music, should be very happy.

fullTextZH: 其实他变得没那么开心了，
fullTextEN: Actually, he became less happy,

fullTextZH: 因为那个时候他才 4 岁，
fullTextEN: because at that time he was only 4 years old,

fullTextZH: 每天他都要练习两个小时以上的钢琴。
fullTextEN: and he had to practice piano for more than two hours every day.

fullTextZH: 他的钢琴老师很严格很凶。
fullTextEN: His piano teacher was very strict and fierce.

fullTextZH: 如果他弹错了或是不专心，
fullTextEN: If he played wrong or was not focused,
his teacher would hit him.
His mother was also very strict,

fullTextZH: 有的时候他实在不想练习，
fullTextEN: Sometimes he really doesn't want to practice,

fullTextZH: 他的妈妈就会拿着棍子站在他的后面看着他，
fullTextEN: His mom would stand behind him with a stick watching him,
until he finishes practicing.
If he disobeys,
his mom would hit him,

fullTextZH: 当其他的小朋友在玩在看电视的时候，
fullTextEN: When other kids are playing and watching TV,

fullTextZH: 周杰伦却得练习弹钢琴，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou had to practice playing the piano,
he felt it was so unfair.
You think,
if it were you,
would you give up playing the piano?
Jay Chou also once wanted to give up,
didn't want to learn piano anymore,
but when he calmed down,
he couldn't help but want to play again,

fullTextZH: 所以他没有放弃弹钢琴。
fullTextEN: so he didn't give up playing the piano.

fullTextZH: 到了他小学三年级的时候，
fullTextEN: By the time he was in third grade,

fullTextZH: 他主动跟妈妈说他要学大提琴。
fullTextEN: he proactively told his mom he wanted to learn the cello.

fullTextZH: 每次他去上大提琴课的时候，
fullTextEN: Every time he went to cello class,

fullTextZH: 他要背着好大好重的大提琴，
fullTextEN: he had to carry a very big and heavy cello,
Go to class by bus by myself.

fullTextZH: 他的妈妈看了觉得很心疼，
fullTextEN: His mother felt very distressed after seeing it,

fullTextZH: 可是周杰伦觉得能背着大提琴走来走去很酷。
fullTextEN: But Jay Chou thought carrying a cello around was cool.

fullTextZH: 周杰伦花这么多时间在弹钢琴学音乐，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou spent so much time playing piano and learning music,

fullTextZH: 又没有其他兄弟姐妹一起玩，
fullTextEN: and had no siblings to play with,
so his personality was very introverted,
and he had no friends.
When he was 14 years old,
his parents divorced.
His grades were already not good,
and were affected by his parents' divorce,
his grades became even worse.
He also became quieter,
until he went to high school,

fullTextZH: 他发现很多人都羡慕他会弹钢琴，
fullTextEN: he found that many people admired his piano skills,
and because he could play piano,
many female classmates liked him,
thinking he was very talented.

fullTextZH: 所以到这个时候他开始有了自信，
fullTextEN: So by this time he started to gain confidence,
and made some good friends,

fullTextZH: 这些好朋友也鼓励他自己作曲，
fullTextEN: These good friends also encouraged him to compose his own music,
which means writing songs himself.
It was at this time,
that Jay Chou truly realized,

fullTextZH: 他的钢琴能弹得这么好，
fullTextEN: his piano skills could be so good,
he had to thank his mother,

fullTextZH: 感谢妈妈拿着棍子逼他练习。
fullTextEN: thank his mother for forcing him to practice with a stick.

fullTextZH: 所以他写了一首歌叫做《听妈妈的话》送给他的妈妈。
fullTextEN: So he wrote a song called 'Listen to Mother's Words' for his mother.
He wants to tell all the children,

fullTextZH: 不要因为妈妈逼你练习，
fullTextEN: not to be angry with your mother for forcing you to practice,

fullTextZH: 逼你努力学习就生妈妈的气，
fullTextEN: forcing you to study hard and then getting mad at your mother,

fullTextZH: 要知道现在努力以后才会有收获，
fullTextEN: you should know that working hard now will lead to rewards later,

fullTextZH: 长大以后你会感谢妈妈。
fullTextEN: when you grow up, you will thank your mother.

fullTextZH: 你们小时候有听妈妈的话吗？
fullTextEN: Did you listen to your mother when you were young?

fullTextZH: 现在你知道周杰伦长大的故事，
fullTextEN: Now you know the story of Jay Chou growing up,

fullTextZH: 你会更了解周杰伦是怎样写出这首听妈妈的话，
fullTextEN: you will better understand how Jay Chou wrote the song 'Listen to Mother's Words',
you can go listen to this song,

fullTextZH: 然后告诉我你喜不喜欢周杰伦的音乐。
fullTextEN: then tell me if you like Jay Chou's music.

fullTextZH: 接下来你想不想知道，为什么这么有才华的周杰伦从学校毕业后没有很快的变成一个明星呢？
fullTextEN: Next, do you want to know why such a talented Jay Chou didn't quickly become a star after graduating from school?

fullTextZH: 而是去餐厅当服务生端盘子呢？
fullTextEN: but instead went to work as a waiter in a restaurant?
If you want to know,

fullTextZH: 欢迎你去 lazy Chinese 的网站。
fullTextEN: You are welcome to visit the lazy Chinese website.

fullTextZH: 你会在这里找到更多关于周杰伦的故事。
fullTextEN: You will find more stories about Jay Chou here.
Then we'll see you in the next episode,
Bye bye.
